x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

def gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

if n >= y:
    m = gcd(x, y)
    a = x // m
    b = y // m
else:
    min_diff = float('inf')
    a, b = 0, 1
    ratio = x / y
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        aa_floor = int((x * i) // y)
        diff_floor = abs((aa_floor / i) - ratio)
        if diff_floor < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff_floor
            a = aa_floor
            b = i
        aa_ceil = int((x * i + y - 1) // y)
        diff_ceil = abs((aa_ceil / i) - ratio)
        if diff_ceil < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff_ceil
            a = aa_ceil
            b = i

print(f"{a}/{b}")
